summary: Artifact songbird: for 10 minutes its song lets you cast its spells as a Bonus Action (DC 18) and keeps those near it truthful.
text: As a Magic action you can set this mechanical bird singing for 10 minutes (audible 300 feet away), or stop it early; once it stops it can't sing again for an hour. It has 6 charges and regains 1d6 + 1 expended charges each dawn. While it sings, as a Bonus Action you can cast from it (save DC 18): Detect Evil and Good or Speak with Animals (no charge), Calm Emotions (1 charge), Slow (2), Compulsion (3), Greater Restoration (4), or Delayed Blast Fireball or Prismatic Spray (6). While it sings, a 15-foot area around it works as Zone of Truth (DC 18) and you know who saves, and once per dawn you can take a Reaction to cast Counterspell (DC 18) from it. It carries two minor beneficial properties, one major beneficial property and one minor detrimental property. Releasing it into a whirlwind in Limbo destroys it. (Its Zone of Truth plays out in conversation; no creature in a fight casts a spell the game lets you counter.)

powers.name: Song
powers.text: Magic action: the bird sings for 10 minutes (then rests for an hour).
